BamBuk's Tip-Proof Tandem E-Trike Brings New Freedom to Those With Limited Physical Abilities
15 photos
Photo: BamBuk
Cycling has typically always been a single-occupant activity, at least, if you’re not riding in a group. However, over the years, tandem bicycles made their appearance, unlocking rides on two wheels with multiple occupants on the same frame.
Tandem bicycles are those rides you see out there upon which two or more riders share the same frame and ride dynamics , at least, in its simplest form. There are also some wild tandems that explore the presence of more than just two people, with the world record holder rolling in with a length of 117 ft and 5 in, and capable of handling as many people as will fit; it’s basically like a warehouse support beam.
Photo: BamBuk As the years rolled by and we’ve exhausted bicycle frame styles and abilities, at least, at first sight, we’ve begun to mix and match, almost crossbreed cycling disciplines, giving rise to new variations. Toss in the electrification of our world, and cycling design and capabilities have simply snowballed into the sort of creatures we see these days.
This brings us to the option we have before us today, a recumbent tandem bike that is also electrified to assist us in moving around town with a load that’s double what we normally experience on a bicycle. Sure, the second pedaling system will help split the work, but having electric assistance just takes the whole thing to a new level of ease-of-use.
Now, the tandem e-tricycle from BamBuk, the centerpiece of our discussion today, is one of those cycling options that frankly, upon seeing it for the first time, inspired me to complete this article, and there are countless reasons why you explore further.
Photo: BamBuk First and foremost, as a tandem option, you and a loved one can hop on and get that blood flowing, together. That alone means afternoon rides of a different vibe, ones where we smile and tell jokes as the landscape progresses.
Secondly, it means a vehicle and an activity that’s accessible to as many people as possible, and in various stages of health. Due to the electric assistance, the BamBuk e-trike means that it can be used by persons with limited mobility, strength, and various ages.
This brings us back to the first benefit, and one of the scenarios that I imagined the moment I locked eyes with this urban mobility solution. As we age, we can’t deny that the body starts to break down, and my parents and I are no exception from the rule.
So, I saw the BamBuk as a wonderful solution to take my mom out for a ride, sharing laughs and bonding along the way, and with electric assistance ensuring that she can manage the ride, even with some of the health issues her body is subject to.
Photo: BamBuk Considering that a 5th generation Bosch CX motor is in place on the BamBuk, capable of producing a whopping 120 Nm of torque, so even with limited strength, there’s ample assistance to move both people with ease.
As you’d expect, this power is drawn from a battery pack, and Bosch continues to supply the spunk. With a 545 Wh battery, BamBuk mentions a peak ride time of up to 70 km (44 miles), but we can also add another pack, so doubling range to as much as 140 km (88 miles). That’s ample juice even if you encounter hills while two people are enjoying the ride.
Overall, the BamBuk is typically sold in one style , but that frame can be equipped with a wide range of features and equipment, in the process, creating three different trim levels that start off at as much as €10,462 ($11,450) and as high as €15,638 ($17,100), as much as some used cars, even some new ones.
Be sure to explore each trim level to see what it brings to the table. But, as an idea of what to expect, think Rohloff gearboxes, freewheel for the rear rider, quad-piston brakes, and adjustability you won’t believe.
Photo: BamBuk One of the coolest tricks of the BamBuk e-trikes is that they have an adjustable frame that we can collapse to reduce its length to as little as 2 meters (6.5 ft), allowing us to toss it on the rear of an RV or camper and exploring the wildest of places. It’s a trick that not very many, if any, tandem trikes can achieve.
Last but not least, Bambuk mentions that they’ve taken things to the next level, having developed a tip-proof trike, and the way they do it is with the suspension system integrated into the trikes. Each wheel is supported by an independent system, and the frame flexes a bit when the front and rear take hits at different times.
Sure, the BamBuk e-trike is one hella expensive mobility solution, but if you think about the level of bonding and mobility that this solution can bring back into your life is not to be overlooked, especially if someone in the family is subject to limited strength and health.
